vibe_rationale: New Zealand's longest-running street art festival (since 2011), free and curated across 8 to 10 walls, a strong single-scene core with civic backing.
fit_notes: Free, family-friendly town-centre event, so the crowd skews broad rather than adult health. Seventeen listed partners and a get-involved page make a wall or community role realistic at low cost; it is a New Zealand event.
